plugins.name: servicenow-docs
plugins.description: Live, searchable access to ServiceNow's official AI Platform documentation. Reads the ServiceNowDocs repo's llms.txt index and fetches individual topic files on demand from GitHub - always current, no local clone required. Requires uv (a one-line install) so the bundled Fetch MCP server can start.
